patches.note_zh: 10.1.0 PTB 带来 Chorus of Sin 章节测试、新杀手 The Judgment、新幸存者 Aurora、Gameplay Showcase 教学入口、Unhook Protections 调整，以及涵盖角色、技能、地图与 UI 的大规模平衡和修复；Sadako 与 Twins 在本轮 PTB 中暂时停用。
patches.note_en: 10.1.0 PTB introduces Chorus of Sin testing with new Killer The Judgment, new Survivor Aurora, the Gameplay Showcase learning hub, updated unhook protections, and a broad balance-and-fix pass across characters, perks, maps, and UI; Sadako and The Twins are temporarily disabled in this PTB.

patches.note_zh: 10.0.3 修正 The Slasher 的跨楼层反蹲守判定，更新 Cross-Examination 触发条件与多项附加组件，并为 Summer Screams 的 Chaos Shuffle / Lights Out / 2v8 周轮换做准备。
patches.note_en: 10.0.3 fixes The Slasher’s cross-floor anti-camp logic, updates Cross-Examination and several add-ons, and sets up the Summer Screams weekly rotation of Chaos Shuffle, Lights Out, and 2v8.

patches.note_zh: 10.0.2 重新启用周年活动队列中的 Doctor，下调 The Slasher 的 Deputy’s Badge 触发范围，并集中修复 Black Banquet、音频、角色、地图与 Perk 问题。
patches.note_en: 10.0.2 re-enables The Doctor in the anniversary queue, nerfs The Slasher’s Deputy’s Badge trigger range, and ships a focused bug-fix pass across Black Banquet, audio, characters, maps, and perks.

patches.note_zh: 10.0.1 上线 Shane Wiigwaas 及其 3 个新技能，并为 6 月 25 日开启的 Black Banquet 十周年活动做准备，同时修复大量音频、角色、地图、Perk 与 UI 问题。
patches.note_en: 10.0.1 ships Shane Wiigwaas and his 3 perks, prepares the June 25 Black Banquet anniversary event, and fixes a large set of audio, character, map, perk, and UI issues.

patches.note_zh: 10.0.0 正式服上线 Jason 章节与 The Slasher，同步加入 Aura 自定义、Killer Power Match Details 页，并修复大量角色、音频与地图问题。
patches.note_en: 10.0.0 brings the live Jason chapter and The Slasher, plus aura customization, a Killer Power Match Details tab, and a large bug-fix pass across characters, audio, and maps.

patches.note_zh: 10.0.0 PTB 开放 Jason 章节测试，带来 The Slasher、Omnipresent Evil / Throwing Spikes 能力，以及新一轮 Perk 与 UI 变更。
patches.note_en: 10.0.0 PTB opens the Jason chapter test with The Slasher, Omnipresent Evil / Throwing Spikes, and a fresh round of perk and UI changes.

store.name: 黎明杀机
store.short_description: 10年恐惧相伴。10年的惊吓与刺激体验。10年的残暴献祭与惊险逃脱。 永久困于邪恶的幻境之中，即使死亡也无法逃脱，这是一场需要勇气和智慧的较量，四名意志坚定的逃生者在残忍对局中面对嗜血杀手。选择一方，进入多人非对称竞技游戏世界，获得最佳恐怖游戏体验。
store.short_description_en: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.
